patterns: Independent stations depend on a failing relay. Rescue stranded crews, bargain for fuel and decide who controls the only safe route.
A quarantine exposes the price of imperial stability. Inspect sealed cargo, negotiate conflicting orders and decide whether to reveal a dangerous treaty.
A dead beacon transmits tomorrow's distress call. Explore abandoned gates, question unreliable records and choose what knowledge the frontier should inherit.
factions:
Relay Cooperative|keeps rescue lanes open but needs an independent witness to expose diverted fuel
Solar Directorate|offers quarantine clearance in exchange for surrendering the encrypted treaty
Nightglass Survey|wants the beacon repaired before its forecasting experiment becomes public
Drift Salvagers|owns the stranded tug and demands payment before releasing its distress recording
Helios Assembly|can overrule military orders if the crew produces unaltered cargo manifests
Quiet Archive|preserves the names erased from the beacon and refuses to destroy its memory
Freewake Couriers|will carry relief supplies through the blockade if given a route nobody owns
Cinder Labor Union|threatens to stop the docks unless contaminated workers receive treatment
locations:

scenes:
Signal in the Wreckage|Objective: board the powerless tug. Tow it or seal its reactor; delay costs the safe docking window
Quarantine at Sunforge|Objective: obtain medicine clearance. Inspect the hold or call a civilian hearing; delay worsens the workers' exposure
The Unlit Beacon|Objective: find the caller. Trace the signal or recover erased logs; delay activates the prediction loop
The Fuel Bargain|Objective: secure rescue cells. Trade salvage rights or expose the diversion; delay triggers the auction
Contradictory Orders|Objective: stop the blockade escalating. Compare signed directives or protect the neutral clerk; delay brings the cruiser
Mirror Crossing|Objective: find the return corridor. Use silence or anchor a beacon; delay releases an echo stalker
A Cable Under Fire|Objective: evacuate families. Hold off corsairs or rig a second towline; delay separates the rescue convoy
Witness at the Ring|Objective: preserve testimony. Escort the clerk or broadcast the original seal; delay allows its seizure
The Names Beneath|Objective: recover missing people. Restore name plates or negotiate with the sentinel; delay erases another record
The Civilian Tow|Objective: save the relay. Share reserve power or persuade Ferry Nine to assist; delay destroys docking clamps
The Reactor Ward|Objective: deliver treatment. Bargain with security or enter the maintenance shaft; delay quarantines the medical team
A Weapon in the Lens|Objective: separate rescue knowledge from targeting data. Isolate the link or confront its researcher; delay publishes the coordinates
The Last Passenger|Objective: protect the last evacuation. Board the captain's tug or reroute the corsairs; delay sacrifices the chart
The Open Tribunal|Objective: decide the treaty's fate. Present evidence or negotiate amnesty; delay lets the admiral close proceedings
The Caretaker's Price|Objective: secure a safe return. Trade a memory or rewrite the beacon contract; delay traps the expedition
A Route for Everyone|Objective: settle ownership. Sign a habitat deed or create a courier cooperative; record who pays for repairs
A Quarantine Lifted|Objective: settle responsibility. Demand reparations or accept a protected confession; record who can enter the docks
Tomorrow Changed|Objective: choose the experiment's future. Preserve an open archive or dismantle prediction; record who keeps the recovered names
archetypes:
Rescue Pilot|flies a damaged civilian tug and owes its crew a safe return
Neutral Inspector|can read contradictory legal seals and has a relative in the sealed ward
Gate Surveyor|maps unstable corridors and recognizes their partner's voice in the signal
Habitat Engineer|repairs docking systems and protects a community's dwindling reserves
Union Medic|treats radiation exposure and needs the original shipment released
Memory Archivist|restores lost identities and refuses to turn personal records into weapons
Freewake Courier|knows blockade routes and wants them shared instead of auctioned
Embassy Witness|preserves signed testimony and risks prosecution for an earlier seizure
progressionPaths:
Route Steward|earns renown by keeping an evacuation route open; gain a courier contact and responsibility for repairs
Treaty Mediator|earns renown by securing treatment without suppressing evidence; gain hearing access and a public obligation
Gate Custodian|earns renown by recovering identities without leaking targeting data; gain archive access and consent duties
Cooperative Captain|earns renown by surrendering a profitable salvage claim; gain a civilian crew and their maintenance costs
Independent Auditor|earns renown by preserving disputed testimony; gain neutral inspection authority and political scrutiny
Frontier Cartographer|earns renown by marking a safe return; gain survey support while publishing hazards honestly
visualThemes:
Rescue Navigation|amber civilian beacons, cyan tow lanes and dark blue habitat schematics distinguish shelter from hazards
Solar Protocol|white inspection grids and vermilion quarantine bands separate permitted routes from military boundaries
Quiet Star Chart|violet memory traces and pale gate rings distinguish recovered locations from unstable predictions
